data.statement: Genesis presents an unconditional promise to Abraham of descendants, land and blessing to the nations.
data.interpretive_divergence: Scope of "blessing to the nations" is interpreted differently across traditions.

provenance.label: Finding
provenance.detail: The Abrahamic promise is stated without conditional obligation clauses.

provenance.label: Claims used
provenance.detail: Promise of land; promise of descendants; blessing to nations.

provenance.label: Supporting evidence
provenance.detail: Covenant ceremony of Genesis 15 and its ancient Near Eastern parallels.

provenance.label: Interpretations
provenance.detail: Traditions differ on the ongoing scope of land and descendants.

provenance.label: Counterviews
provenance.detail: Readings that regard Genesis 17 as introducing conditionality.
